question: Who among the following was the first Indian representative in modern Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norman Pritchard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Norman Pritchard** was the first Indian representative at the modern Olympics.
 
• He participated in the **1900 Paris Olympics**.
 
• Pritchard competed in **athletics**, specifically in sprinting events.
 
• He won **two silver medals** in the 200 meters and 200 meters hurdles events.
 
• Pritchard's participation marked India's debut in the Olympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Milkha Singh:**

 
 
• Also known as the "Flying Sikh," Milkha Singh was a renowned Indian sprinter.
 
• He represented India in the 1956, 1960, and 1964 Olympics.
 
• Milkha Singh's most notable Olympic performance was in the 400 meters final at the 1960 Rome Olympics, where he finished fourth.
 
 
 
• **KD Jadhav:**
 
 
• Khashaba Dadasaheb Jadhav was the first Indian athlete to win an individual Olympic medal.
 
• He won a bronze medal in wrestling at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Nilima Ghose:**
 
 
• Nilima Ghose was the first Indian woman to participate in the Olympics.
 
• She competed in the 1952 Helsinki Olympics in athletics.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Games:**
 
 
• The modern Olympic Games are an international multi-sport event occurring every four years.
 
• The Games are governed by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The first modern Olympics were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896.
